# refactor volumes and volume aliases

Reshape the Docker volume helpers ([#13](DOT-13.md)) into one command with subcommands:

```
$ volumes -> volume
$ volume ls
$ volume ls ...id
$ volume attach ...id
$ volume clean
$ volume rm
```

Today `volumes [all|clean]` lists or prunes and `volume <name>` mounts a volume into an `alpine` shell; the proposal merges them under `volume` with explicit verbs (`ls` with optional ids, `attach`, `clean`, `rm`). The second note is unrelated to Docker: trim Oh My Zsh's `grep` alias from `grep --color=auto --exclude-dir={.bzr,CVS,.git,.hg,.svn,.idea,.tox}` to `grep --color=auto`, i.e. stop the `common-aliases` plugin from hiding results in `.idea`/`.git`.
